config.expected_if_false: Final N=64 layer-1 trained force R2 <= 0.839 (gap <= 0.02). That would mean N=128 seed 23 converges to roughly the N=64 level at 24000 steps, so its deficit is slow convergence. A gap in (0.02, 0.04) is inconclusive.
config.expected_if_true: Final N=64 layer-1 trained force R2 >= 0.859 (gap >= 0.04 vs 0.81915), force margin >= 0.1, horizon check passes, and the accel_step headroom-normalised margin is in [0.60, 0.85].
config.hypothesis: Matched-horizon reference for the seed-23 data_seed 1 ceiling test. Setup: m2 fixed at 0.5, N=64, seed 23, 4 layers, d_model=64, e in [0, 0.5], best-of-3 controls, 24000 steps. Prediction: the final layer-1 trained force R2 (probes_final, unrounded) stays at least 0.04 above the same-layer 24000-step N=128 seed-23 value of 0.81915 (run-20261015-225826-a2d5). If so, the small N=128 deficit is a real lower ceiling at matched layer and horizon. The N=64 best-margin layer is reported, and a best layer other than 1 is flagged as cross-layer. Intermediate values are read only as same-layer control plus margin, never from the max-over-layers trajectory field. Horizon check: the step-12000 layer-1 value must be within 0.03 of the 12000-step N=64 seed-23 run's layer-1 value of 0.8467 (run-20261014-074634-b5ab). If it is not, the result is reported as horizon-confounded. Both reference run IDs are cited as evidence.
